verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, since vendors can ship on-premises or distributed editions, but the evidence pack documents no self-hostable or on-prem version of Google Cloud itself. The Firestore local emulator is explicitly for local testing only and not production, the open-source MCP Toolbox is an auxiliary tool rather than the core product, and Workload Identity Federation only lets on-prem workloads access Google-hosted resources; these are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
